# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

I can't browse, so I can't confirm live prices or give direct product pages. Each link below goes to the article or deal page that covers the product and has the buy buttons.

## My top picks

**1. Soundcore Space One, best overall**
- It lists at $99.99, and the code AFSC20 brings it to about $80. The code was tested on 2026-10-22 and expires 2026-12-31.
- It has adaptive ANC, 40 hours of battery with ANC on, multipoint, and LDAC for Android.
- It's a bit heavy at 265 g and has no sweat resistance.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link. [Dealectric's page](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100-2026-reviews-prices) has the details. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/) also names it its top pick under $100.

**2. Anker Soundcore Space Q45, strongest noise cancelling**
- RTINGS found its noise isolation the best of the budget group, quieting engine rumble and chatty coworkers. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- Its price "hovers around the $100 mark," so it may land slightly over. CartIQ lists it at $99. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- The sources disagree on battery life. RTINGS measured 28 hours, while CartIQ claims 50 hours with ANC off and 38 with it on. I'd trust RTINGS's lab testing.
- Some owners report the headband cracking over time.

**3. Sony WH-CH720N, lightest and most comfortable**
- It's $99 on Amazon sale per CartIQ and weighs 192 g. It has 35 hours of battery with ANC on, and its ANC handles office hum and keyboard noise well.
- It supports only SBC and AAC, with no LDAC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

## Cheaper options

- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** RTINGS's "best cheap" pick. It nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation, with 49 hours of battery. Its build is plasticky, and the earpads can flake. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Edifier W820NB Plus ($79):** 49-hour battery, LDAC, and plush earcups, but no case. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45):** very good value, with ANC rated up to 44 dB and a light, foldable design. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE ($65):** 70-hour battery, but weaker ANC and no app. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/) TechRadar picks the 1More SonoFlow Pro as its best under $100. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (~$79):** best mic for calls and bass-heavy sound, but RTINGS found its ANC mediocre. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

## Which to choose
- **Quietest:** Space Q45
- **Best all-rounder with a discount:** Space One
- **Lightweight and comfortable:** Sony WH-CH720N
- **Tightest budget:** Edifier Atom Max or 1MORE SonoFlow SE

Prices at these retailers change often, so check the final price before you buy.
